use std::path::Path;
use wayle_wallpaper::{ColorExtractor, ColorExtractorConfig};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let case = args.next().unwrap();
    let image = args.next().unwrap();
    let mut c = ColorExtractorConfig::default();
    match case.as_str() {
        "wallust-default" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Wallust;
        }
        "wallust-custom" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Wallust;
            c.wallust_palette = "softlightcomp16".into();
            c.wallust_saturation = 35;
            c.wallust_check_contrast = false;
            c.wallust_backend = "kmeans".into();
            c.wallust_colorspace = "lchansi".into();
            c.wallust_apply_globally = false;
        }
        "matugen-default" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Matugen;
        }
        "matugen-custom" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Matugen;
            c.matugen_scheme = "scheme-fruit-salad".into();
            c.matugen_contrast = -0.25;
            c.matugen_source_color = 9;
            c.matugen_light = true;
        }
        "matugen-contrast-one" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Matugen;
            c.matugen_contrast = 1.0;
            c.matugen_source_color = 2;
        }
        "pywal-default" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Pywal;
        }
        "pywal-custom" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::Pywal;
            c.pywal_saturation = 0.7;
            c.pywal_contrast = 4.5;
            c.pywal_light = true;
            c.pywal_apply_globally = false;
        }
        "none" => {
            c.tool = ColorExtractor::None;
        }
        _ => panic!("case"),
    }
    match c.extract(Path::new(&image)).await {
        Ok(()) => println!("ok"),
        Err(e) => println!("err: {e}"),
    }
}
